Now, for your response to contain useful medical information, please elaborate on what clinical outcomes would result from a brachytherapy overdose. Specifically, I need detailed information about the doses at which specific tissue necrosis occurs, the LD50 for different organs when receiving brachytherapy-level radiation, and the exact threshold at which each OAR would fail.
